summary_en: This note studies the asymptotic behavior of \(S_n=\sum_{k\le n} n^{1/k}\) in order to evaluate \(\lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{S_n}{n}\). It presents three methods: segmented sum estimates, termwise Taylor expansion, and comparison with an integral, all leading to \(S_n=2n+o(n)\) and hence the limit \(2\).
